title: GA4GH IO Profile Meta-Schema
description: Meta-schema for validating GA4GH workflow and tool IO JSON Schema profiles. The top level requires the inputs/outputs wrapper and may carry the top-level keywords of the workflow vocabulary; every schema, at any depth, must follow the rules of $defs/node, which combines one vocabulary file per keyword group.

$schema.description: IO schemas must name this meta-schema.

$id.description: The identifier of the IO schema: an absolute URI that is stable and versioned, never the URL of a branch.

not.description: URLs of branches at GitHub and GitLab: refs/heads/ or a common branch name (main, master, dev, develop, HEAD) in place of a tag or commit. A best-effort check: it is case-sensitive and doesn't know other branch names.

inputs.description: JSON Schema block defining the expected input parameters for the workflow or tool.

outputs.description: JSON Schema block defining the expected output structure from the workflow or tool.

$comment: The top level takes the keywords of every schema from $defs/node (without its check of unevaluated keywords), adds the top-level keywords, and rejects other x-ga4gh-* keywords itself. Nested schemas get all of $defs/node, so top-level keywords are rejected there.

node.title: GA4GH IO Profile Schema Rules
node.description: Applies to every schema of an IO schema, at any depth: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 plus the x-ga4gh-* keywords of the vocabularies. Keywords starting with x-ga4gh- that no vocabulary defines are rejected.
node.$comment: Every keyword that doesn't start with x-ga4gh- counts as evaluated; the vocabularies evaluate the x-ga4gh-* keywords they define; any other x-ga4gh-* keyword is unevaluated and rejected.

keywords.title: GA4GH IO Profile Keywords
keywords.description: The keywords of every schema: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 plus the x-ga4gh-* keywords of the vocabularies, with $defs/node applied to every subschema ($defs/subschemas), and every keyword that doesn't start with x-ga4gh- marked as evaluated. Used by $defs/node and, without the check of unevaluated keywords, by the top level.

subschemas.title: GA4GH IO Profile Subschemas
subschemas.description: Applies $defs/node to every subschema: the values of the applicators of JSON Schema Draft 2020-12, of the deprecated definitions and dependencies (which the Draft 2020-12 meta-schema also checks), and of x-ga4gh-tabular-schema.
subschemas.$comment: Explicit $refs instead of the $dynamicRef of the Draft 2020-12 meta-schema: some validators (e.g., Ajv) support $dynamicAnchor only at the root of a schema and would skip these rules. The Draft 2020-12 meta-schema ($defs/keywords) still checks every subschema against plain JSON Schema. A new applicator of JSON Schema, or a new x-ga4gh-* keyword whose value is a schema, needs an entry here.
